title: Fairfax Media Limited - proposed acquisition of Southern Independent Publishers Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from a party to the transaction. ACCC timeline suspended.
Further information received from a party to the transaction. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Fairfax Media Limited proposed to acquire the Kiama Independent and Lake Times newspapers from Southern Independent Publishers.
